question: What monitoring frequencies do opaque LIMIT_FREQ_OF_ANALYSIS_CODE values (e.g. 05/WK, 01/07, 01/01) establish?

judgment.semantic_question_used: What monitoring frequency does limit_freq_of_analysis_code 01/07 require for this permit limit row (total suspended solids daily maximum 50 mg/L at Outfall 001 under permit NM0000116)?
judgment.interpretation: Monitoring is required once per week (1/Week), using grab samples, for the total suspended solids daily maximum limit of 50 mg/L at Outfall 001.
judgment.grounding: The structured permit_limits row for limit_value_id 3610129867 carries LIMIT_FREQ_OF_ANALYSIS_CODE 01/07 for parameter 00530 (Solids, total suspended), daily maximum (statistical base DD) of 50 mg/L, grab sample type GR, on permit NM0000116 Outfall 001. Part I Section A of the final permit for NM0000116 lists the matching Total Suspended Solids row—Daily Max 50 mg/L—with measurement frequency 1/Week and sample type Grab. The fact sheet for the same permit states that, based on facility discharge frequency, all limited parameters other than pH have weekly monitoring frequency requirements.

judgment.remaining_uncertainty: The workspace contains no general ICIS code legend defining 01/07; the weekly frequency is established from permit narrative text matched to this specific limit row (parameter, statistical base, limit value, and sample type), not from a reusable code table. Whether weekly sampling is triggered only when a discharge occurs is a separate discharge-occurrence condition not resolved by the frequency code alone.
